name: Морской бой
tagline: Спрячьте свой флот, а потом найдите и потопите чужой, клетка за клеткой.
description: Играйте в морской бой бесплатно в браузере: спрячьте пять кораблей на поле 10 × 10 и потопите чужой флот первым. С ботами, вдвоём или онлайн.
about: Sea Battle is the pencil-and-paper game of hidden ships, played on squared paper in classrooms everywhere. Each player hides a fleet on a 10 × 10 grid and takes turns firing at the other's waters, one square at a time.

Your fleet has five ships, of 5, 4, 3, 3 and 2 squares, each in a straight line across or down; ships can't overlap. A shot is a miss, a hit, or, when the last square of a ship is hit, a sinking, and the whole ship is shown.
Sink all five ships before the other player sinks yours. Play taking turns, or let a hit fire again. Online, both fleets are kept on our server, so nobody can peek at the other's grid.
howToPlay: Choose taking turns or shooting again after a hit, then Play vs bots, Play on this device, or create a room.
Place your fleet: pick a ship, then tap the square where it starts. Rotate turns it across or down.
Drag a placed ship to move it, or press Random to place the rest. Press Ready when all five are in.
Then fire: tap a square of the other player's waters. A dot is a miss, a cross a hit.
A sunk ship is shown whole. Your own waters, below, show where the other player has fired.
On one device, pass it on when asked, so nobody sees the other fleet.
controls: Phones and tablets: tap to place and fire; drag a placed ship to move it.
Mouse: click to place and fire; drag a placed ship to move it.
Keyboard: Tab to a grid, the arrow keys to move between squares, Enter to place or fire.
tips: Every ship covers a square of each colour on a checkerboard: hunt on one colour first.
After a hit, try the four squares around it; after two in a line, keep going along it.
Don't line your ships up along the edges: that's where many players look first.
Ships far apart are harder to find than a cluster.

faq.question: Is Sea Battle free to play?
faq.answer: Yes. kefche is free, has no ads, and you don't need an account to play.

faq.question: Can ships touch?
faq.answer: Yes, they may touch, but not overlap. Each ship lies in a straight line across or down.

faq.question: Can the other player see my fleet?
faq.answer: No. Online, both fleets are kept on our server; your browser only learns where your own shots landed.

faq.question: What does "shoot again" do?
faq.answer: With it on, a hit fires again at once, as in many schoolyard rules. With it off, players simply take turns.

faq.question: Can I play on one phone with a friend?
faq.answer: Yes. Play on this device asks you to pass the phone between turns, so neither of you sees the other's ships.
